issues.title: Drop passcode in role, use role-id
issues.body:
We've added role-id for roles.

We can now drop the `password` - and use `roleid` in every place that was used.  I can think of:
* [x] Password box for `forces` admin page
* [x] Injecting the password in the quick-login links on the welcome page
* [x] Checking the password is valid for a user at login page
* [x] Short-cutting into the app via the `access` parameter in the URL

We should lastly remove `password` from the `Role` object.

issues.title: Assigning roles in Settings - Channels not working
issues.body:
Two visible issues:
1. when we try to assign a role, only the first value gets added
2. when we store the changes to the database, `null` values are inserted.

## Wrongly selecting first role
![screencast](https://i.gyazo.com/7b8b4c7d85d26da2ac5fd1fabba4131d.gif)

## Nulls in database
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/127625612-d318745a-5fb9-4c05-96e1-9bcfd8fd471a.png)

comments.body: Ok, after investigating this, I'm pretty sure it's when we encounter a legacy wargame (such as `CmdWeek High Data` that either uses `password` and not `roleId` for roles, or which stores the whole `Role` object in the `roles` part of the participant element.
